news.title: Senate Spending Bill Would Temporarily Block OMB's Federal Grants Overhaul
news.summary_en: A spending bill released by the Senate Appropriations Committee would delay implementation of the Trump administration's proposed overhaul of federal grants regulations, which drew more than 50,000 overwhelmingly negative public comments.

news.title: ACE, Others Urge ED to Preserve Title VI Regulatory Framework
news.summary_en: ​​​​​ACE and a group of other higher ed associations urged the ED to withdraw its proposal to rescind the regulations governing the Title VI International Education Programs and the Fulbright-Hays Program.
